pages.text: The Reconstructed Mind is a block which can eventually evolve into a Proto-Hivemind. They evolve gaining Kill Points, which they can get by entering into contact with a Spore creature that itself got Kill Points, or thanks to a nearby $(l:inf_infested_spawner)Infested Spawner$(/l). $(l)Reconstructed Mind can also be given Kill Points by a stage 3 or 4 Mound that is less than 50 blocks away from the Reconstructed Mind.$()

Reconstructed Minds are placed by stage 3 Mounds or higher, and $(l)each Mound can only place a Reconstructed Mind once in its life$(). Spore creatures may get Kill Points in various ways, most notably by killing other creatures or being spawned by an Overcharged Scent.$(br)$(l)Right click a Reconstructed Mind to see its amount of stored Kill Points.

Once reaching 20 Kills points, the Reconstructed Mind can evolve into a Proto-Hivemind, enabling the advanced stage of the Spore Infestation. Do not let this happen before you are ready. More information can be found in the $(l:proto)Proto-Hivemind chapter$(/l). This block may be invisible from a distance of more than 30 blocks.
If a Proto-Hivemind already exists in less than 300 blocks from the Reconstructed Mind, it will evolve into an Outpost Watcher instead.
